claim: Administrative reduction authority is battalion level for junior enlisted, higher authority above
quote: The reduction authority for SSgts and above are Marine officers exercising general courts-martial convening authority. The reduction authority for Sgts and below are commanders
fix: Reduction authority for SSgt and above is the GCMCA, not 'higher authority'. For Sgt and below it is a commander per 1200.3b. Reduction follows a CRB, for technical or professional incompetence, with counseling first. Rewrite the authority and basis rows.

claim: NJP reduction limits: Maj and above one grade, O-5 one grade
source: MANUAL FOR COURTS-MARTIAL UNITED STATES (2024 EDITION)
quote: an enlisted member in a pay grade above E-4 may not be reduced more than two pay grades
fix: Major or LCDR and above reduce to any intermediate grade, with a two grade limit above E-4. Correct the O-4 and O-5 rows.

claim: NJP appeal due within 5 days
source: MANUAL FOR COURTS-MARTIAL UNITED STATES (2024 EDITION)
quote: An appeal shall be submitted within 5 days of imposition of punishment, or the right to appeal shall be waived in the absence of good cause shown.

claim: Marine elects a board for administrative reduction
quote: Marines may not be reduced for technical and/or professional incompetence without first being afforded the opportunity to appear before a CRB.
fix: A CRB is the required vehicle for incompetence reductions. For PFC and LCpl it is the commander alone. Replace 'elect' with the CRB rule.

claim: E-2 through E-5 promote on composite scores from conduct and proficiency marks
quote: JEPES replaces the legacy Proficiency and Conduct system
fix: JEPES replaced pro and con marks on 1 Feb 2021 and drives Pvt through Sgt promotion. Rewrite the composite score sections, table and steps around JEPES, cutting scores and PME flags (MARADMIN 502/26, MCO 1616.1).

claim: SSgt and above require an HQMC selection board
quote: announces the Fiscal Year 2026 (FY26) United States Marine Corps (USMC) Staff Noncommissioned Officer (SNCO) Promotion Selection Board (PSB) schedule

claim: SNCO boards convene annually or biennially
quote: The FY26 USMC SNCO PSB schedule is:
fix: Boards convene every fiscal year. Remove 'biennially'.

claim: Cites MCO P1400.32 and MCO P1070.12 without letter suffix
quote: REF A IS MCO P1400.32D W/CH2
fix: Current orders are MCO P1400.32D W/CH 2 and MCO P1070.12K. Update the citations.
